drive.note: fusion_rad = sign * model_rad + offset. Since the rg2 v27 rig-at-zero rebuild the CAD drive IS theta_model (re-derived by sweep+arc-fit: slope 1.0, offset <1e-4 deg, dLR 5e-6 deg). Fusion snaps commanded drive values to a 0.05 deg grid (display-side only, <=0.025 deg). The old v26 mapping was sign -1 / offset 17.95.

width.note: raw_mm (Modbus reg 267 / datasheet) = amp*sin(alpha0 + theta_model) + raw_offset; width-with-offset (reg 275 / pad gap) = raw - 2*tip_offset. Source: hardware/rg2.successor.yaml (live-firmware-confirmed).
